outcome: Build jobs choose smaller or larger RAM/CPU through existing named pool routing; exact enforced sizes are charged to the same host budget before pickup, preserving live ownership and release fences.
minimum_design: Extend existing build pool defaults with optional bounded request ceiling; attest Docker hard limits, preserve existing fixed grants, adopt/retry/release exact resource requests; permit reviewed build-* named pools within eight total native slots and unchanged four-builder default floor.

reuse_decisions.name: Existing V3 named pools and GitHub routing labels
reuse_decisions.rationale: Jobs already select named pools with matching hard limits; no new scheduler, workflow parser or container resizing is required.

reuse_decisions.name: Existing shared broker requests, fences and native owner lifecycle
reuse_decisions.rationale: Already owns atomic host accounting, idle withdrawal and recovery; extend resource attestation across classes instead of adding an allocation owner.

expected_structural_delta: Zero new owners, services, dependencies or journals. One optional ceiling in existing Pool, small existing validation helpers, tests and documentation.
